verdict.rationale: GST is India's statutory tax regime, with a government filing portal and API, not a commercial hosting or SaaS product. Letting taxpayers choose a storage region or data residency does not fit this kind of jurisdiction-bound system, so the axis is a category error rather than a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence suggests any region-selection capability exists that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
